questions.question_html: Identify the product of the following Wurtz-Fittig reaction.
questions.solution_html:
First halide bond will cleave to form halide and benzene and then halide will react with sodium. As a result, benzene and sodium bromide is formed.
In second step, there will be a bond cleavage of CH3−Br to form CH3●+NaBr. Free radical CH3● react with benzene to form toluene.

questions.question_html: The total number of SN2 (Nucleophilic substitution bimolecular) reactions involved in the following reaction sequence is _______
questions.solution_html:
Total number of SN2 reactions involved in the reaction is three.
In first SN2 reaction methoxy group is replaced by OH group (i.e. CH3 group replace by H+of HI) .
In second SN 2 reaction another methoxy group get replaced by OH.
In third SN2 reaction OH get replaced by iodide group.
